title: About Us
body_md:
## Who We Are

XL Market (Roland Kaubandus OÜ) is an Estonian e-commerce company specialising in professional tools, catering equipment, and machinery for small and medium-sized businesses.

We are the authorised representative of VEVOR in Estonia and Spain, bringing professional-grade equipment at half the price of traditional distributors.

## Our Mission

**Professional Tools, Half the Price.** We believe every entrepreneur deserves access to proper equipment without compromising their cash flow on day one.

## What We Offer

- 16,000+ SKUs across 18 product categories
- Turnkey starter kits for 6 business types
- B2B accounts with Net-30 terms and volume pricing
- Service plans for maintenance and priority repair
